rows.note: Use this when conduct is morally outrageous or shocking enough to provoke strong abhorrence.

example.english: Those people treated innocent residents abhorrently and were eventually punished by law.
example.traditional: 嗰班人令人髮指咁虐待無辜居民，終於受到法律制裁。
